value.rationale: This family is a natural next small planar sumset beyond the d+2 exact-cardinality regime, motivated by the published general hole-structure problem. Adding one interior diagonal generator to a sparse quadrilateral turns an unbounded boundary-hole count into a stationary finite defect; the exact cubic formula, unique coordinate classification and sharp first stabilization degree give substantive structural and conductor-type information, not merely a computation or generic eventual-polynomial statement.
